title: Late for the Movie
text:
Tomasz wants to go to the cinema with his brother Piotr. He sends a text message at four o'clock. The movie starts at half past six. Piotr does not reply because his phone is off.

At five o'clock, Piotr turns on his phone and reads the message. He quickly writes back: Yes, I'm coming! Tomasz is happy and buys two tickets online. They meet at the bus stop at six o'clock.

questions.text: What time does the movie start?
How does Tomasz probably feel when Piotr replies?
What can we guess about the brothers?

vocabulary.definition: words that one person sends to another, often by phone
to say or write something back to someone
small papers or electronic passes that allow you to enter a place, such as a cinema
feeling good because something nice has happened

paragraph_translations: Tomasz chce pójść do kina ze swoim bratem Piotrem. O czwartej wysyła wiadomość tekstową. Film zaczyna się o wpół do siódmej. Piotr nie odpisuje, bo jego telefon jest wyłączony.
O piątej Piotr włącza telefon i czyta wiadomość. Szybko odpisuje: Tak, idę! Tomasz jest szczęśliwy i kupuje dwa bilety przez internet. Spotykają się na przystanku autobusowym o szóstej.
